ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity predominant across ~95% of visible surface (dark grey/black) with isolated high-intensity clusters (white/tan) located at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pixel field across both lobes; two primary high-contrast contiguous blobs located at the extreme left and right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an acute angle of approximately 55-65 degrees relative to the lobe centerlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; left lobe displays more jagged, high-amplitude peaks compared to the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the posterior trailing edge leading to tapered, upward-sweeping distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular tan/white pixels at the outer edges of both lobes, indicative of barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, faint diagonal linear marks (rake marks) crossing the dark pigment on the mid-to-upper portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized white circular spots (pockmarks) on the central-left lobe surface; significant crustose-textured accumulation at the distal tips.
